note: Stock data only (owner 2026-11-08). The codes each stock poster carries: the event type suggests a starting set, and the stock build makes that choice the way an organizer of that type most likely would, through the same admin route an organizer uses (PUT /api/v2/admin/events/:id/poster-codes). The app never reads this file and no type is locked to a set: an organizer adds or drops any code (lib/poster-codes.ts). Sets: events = the event page code only (/s, with the placement's /q); events+registration adds REGISTER (the event's own form); events+registration+donation adds DONATE (an https link). The largest set is 3 codes, which fits every plan, Free included.
